description: React component for rendering and managing a list item representing a smart view or tag, with editing, selection, and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: SmartViewsListItem
classes.description: React functional component for displaying a smart view list item with editing and interaction capabilities.

methods.name: getIconClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class for the icon based on the view and selection state.

methods.name: selectCurrentTag
methods.description: Sets the current view as selected in the navigation state.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Saves the current title when the input loses focus.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Updates the title state as user types.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key events, specifically 'Enter' to blur input.

methods.name: onClickEdit
methods.description: Triggers editing mode for the current view.

methods.name: onClickDelete
methods.description: Removes the current view from the list.
